name: Civil Disobedience
overview: Scripture presents civil disobedience as a faithful response when earthly authority conflicts with obedience to God. The Hebrew midwives in Exodus 1:15 courageously defied Pharaoh's orders to preserve life, while Daniel and his companions in Daniel 3 and 6 demonstrated unwavering commitment to God through prayer and refusal to worship idols, even under threat of death. Jesus’ teaching in Matthew 22:17 acknowledges the legitimacy of civil obligations, yet the examples in Daniel reveal that God's commands take precedence when human laws demand compromise of faith.
